title: elaeagnus glabra f. oxyphylla
intro: Elaeagnus glabra f. oxyphylla, commonly known as silverberry or wolfberry, is a type of flowering plant in the family Elaeagnaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer effects. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus glabra f. oxyphylla include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, promote wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
